generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

If there is any change in the annual action plan sanction, if there is a change in location and accordingly the work order will be issued as per the estimated sanctioned works. The work should be carried out according to the season, apart from the works already undertaken.
The tender calling authority shall have the power to cancel the tender and re-invite tenders without assigning any reason.
Total value of Forestry works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and on-going Forestry work

Should there be any revision to the physical and financial targets for raising seedlings, the work order shall be issued in accordance with the revised and approved targets. This condition shall be binding upon the successful bidder.

The Department has already approved suppliers for the supply of polythene bags and barbed wire fencing materials. The said materials will be supplied by issuing a supply order from the Department, and the payment will be made directly by the Department. Alternatively, you will have to pay the full bill amount to the concerned suppliers and submit a claim for reimbursement. Payment will be made only upon submission of the claim along with proof of full payment to the suppliers.
All other terms and conditions are as per the bid document uploaded & standard tender document with this tender

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of seedlings 8x12 (6600) under Tegasiri at Shri. Banashankari Nursery during 2026-27

itemList.description: Raising of 4"x6" seedlings for trasplanting into 8"x12" PBs / Teak stumps
Cost of HDPE bags including 18% GST
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cum. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags / Teak stumps
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges.
